Docs.Title: Sec. 2.01. - General grant of powers.
Docs.Content:
The powers set forth in sections 15.2-1100 through 15.2-1131 of the Code of Virginia as in force on January 1, 1977, and as hereafter amended, are hereby conferred on and vested in the City of Virginia Beach. In addition thereto the City of Virginia Beach shall have and may exercise all other powers which are now or may hereafter be conferred upon or delegated to cities of the first class under the Constitution or laws of the Commonwealth, as fully and completely as though such powers were specifically enumerated in this Charter and no enumerations of particular powers in this Charter shall be held to be exclusive but shall be held to be in addition to this general grant of powers.

(Acts 1977, Ch. 14, § 1; Acts 2003, Ch. 869, § 1)
